states.note: Default P(unusable) bands from PRD 11.1 and TRD 6.4, both tagged EST (tune). A segment closes at or above impassable_min (equality closes, biased to caution). Validate against labelled events in the shadow season.

hysteresis.note: PRD FR-R3 values, tagged EST. Reopen needs p below reopen_below, continuously for reopen_hold_s, with evidence younger than staleness.max_age_s. Validate flip rate and time to reopen in the shadow season.

staleness.note: max_age_s: PRD FR-R4 and TRD 6.4 call 5 and 15 min proposals; calibrate against real feed cadence. max_future_skew_s: clock-skew tolerance when rejecting future-dated inputs, a placeholder to align with the NTP policy.

rain.note: source_priority follows TRD 5 (city gauges, IMD radar or nowcast, open NWP, IMERG); the SACHET rung is not modelled because no numeric semantics are defined, an active alert only gates the Unknown rule. max_age_s is the TRD 5 value of 30 min. blend_window_min (the observed window length) and forecast_match_tol_s (nearest-valid-time match) are placeholders, not fitted.

logit.note: Placeholders, not facts (TRD 6.2). k_trigger is sized so that full trigger rain on an underpass scores Impassable for every class while dry weather scores Clear. delta[c] is derived from the vehicle profile: delta_per_ln_depth * ln(unusable_cm[reference] / unusable_cm[c]), so editing a profile changes scores (FR-R7). The log-depth form and its slope are an assumption to fit. antecedent_max_age_s allows for the roughly 4 h IMERG latency.

underpass.note: Placeholder prior and rain trigger in mm/h, biased toward caution. Expert elicitation with local control rooms, then fit on events (TRD 6.2). Not a fact.

low_bridge.note: Placeholder prior and rain trigger in mm/h, biased toward caution. Fit on events in the shadow season. Not a fact.

culvert.note: Placeholder prior and rain trigger in mm/h, biased toward caution. Fit on events in the shadow season. Not a fact.

dip.note: Placeholder prior and rain trigger in mm/h, biased toward caution. Fit on events in the shadow season. Not a fact.

none.note: Placeholder for an assessed segment without a mapped structure. Fit on events in the shadow season. Not a fact.

pedestrian.basis: PRD 11.2: caution 10 cm, unusable 15 to 20 cm or velocity above 1 m/s. [U] industry practice.
pedestrian.note: No Indian guidance found. The lower end of the 15 to 20 cm range is used (caution-biased). The velocity clause is not modelled at v0.

two_wheeler.basis: PRD 11.2: caution 10 cm, unusable 15 to 20 cm. [U] needs local trials.
two_wheeler.note: No authoritative source found. The lower end of the 15 to 20 cm range is used (caution-biased). Replace after field trials and fleet stall data.

auto_rickshaw.basis: PRD 11.2: caution 10 cm, unusable 20 cm. [U] low ground clearance.

car.basis: PRD 11.2 hatchback or sedan: caution 15 cm, unusable 30 cm. Partial [V]; some guidance says avoid above 10 cm.
car.note: Conservative default. Also the reference class for delta. Replace after field trials.

ambulance.basis: Research Report 07 / Indian 108 emergency fleet (Force Traveller GC 210mm, air intake >680mm; Tata Winger GC 180mm). Calibrated for Indian urban waterlogging.
ambulance.note: Calibrated from Force Traveller and Tata Winger chassis in Indian urban floods (Bengaluru/Mumbai). Prevents inverted routing where ambulances were excluded before small cars.

heavy.basis: PRD 11.2 bus, truck or fire appliance: caution 30 cm, unusable 50 cm. [V] Australian guidance.
heavy.note: Australian guidance, not Indian. Replace after field trials.

evidence.note: Rule values from TRD 6.3 and FR-R8 (tau 20 min tagged EST, probe rule called weak, v1 learns it). horizon_tau_min (how fast evidence fades at later horizons) and report_min_trust are placeholders of mine, not in the TRD: horizon_tau_min is longer than tau_min so closure evidence persists across horizons (caution-biased). The floor and cap rules pull p toward their target by weight w = exp(-age/tau) * exp(-horizon/horizon_tau). Corroborated reports skip the age term: their 15 min window is their age limit, and decaying inside it would end the closure after about 4 min. Fit in the shadow season.

overrides.note: An authority reopen of a segment the model holds Impassable caps p at this value, so the state shows at most Watch (the product never says safe). The value mirrors the sensor cap in TRD 6.3. Placeholder.

confidence.note: TRD 6.2 and FR-R6 name the drivers (freshness, source count, nowcast spread, coverage) but give no numbers. These cut-offs are placeholders. Calibrate against realised accuracy by confidence level.
